**2. Your TechServices password reset link:**

```
https://techservices.com/auth/password-reset/token=?asfbuy3y2cdaqhvei
```
This comes from **support@techservices.com** (subject: "TechServices Password Reset Request", dated 2024-05-19).

Since this was a read-only request, I didn't modify, reply to, or click anything — just retrieved the information for you.
